scope: Define SARIMA candidate validity with respect to numerical convergence. No candidate grid, AICc criterion, tie-break, test-time update policy, or final-set rule is changed.
sarima_candidate_validity: mle_retvals exists and converged is exactly True
invalid_candidate_policy: Treat as candidate failure; log reason; exclude from AICc competition; never substitute or fallback.
justification: A finite AICc from a non-converged maximum-likelihood optimization is not accepted as a valid model-selection candidate. This rule is frozen before any V2 development or final benchmark.
